title: F1597 State-Transfer Contract Definition and Nonmatching-Mesh Patch Test Suite
finding: Nonmatching-mesh state-transfer contract and patch test suite verified: (1) Established formal donor-to-receiver state contract covering displacement (ux, uy), phase field (d in [0, 1]), lower-bound irreversibility (d >= d_prior), and history (H >= 0). (2) Patch Test 1 (constant field): Exact reproduction (scalar err = 1.11e-16, vector err = 1.11e-16 <= 1e-12). (3) Patch Test 2 (affine field): First-order bilinear quad completeness verified (max err = 1.11e-16 <= 1e-11). (4) Patch Test 3 (slit flank discontinuity): Exact duplicate-node topological isolation at y=0.050 mm, x<=0.040 mm verified with zero cross-slit leakage (err <= 1.11e-16). (5) Patch Test 4 (bounds and irreversibility): Clamping and lower-bound operator guarantees zero healing nodes. (6) Patch Test 5 (AT2 fracture energy): Discrete Gauss quadrature conserves fracture energy within 0.16% (Donor=0.271250 mJ, Receiver=0.270818 mJ, Diff=0.1589% <= 2.0%). Frozen UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (CE8D5EDCD2911DCB...) is strictly preserved.

displacement_u.continuity_rule: Isoparametric bilinear C0 interpolation from containing donor element
displacement_u.slit_condition: Separate sampling for upper and lower flank duplicate nodes at y=0.050 mm, x<=0.040 mm
displacement_u.boundary_constraints: Preserves bottom fixed (u_y=0), pin (u_x=0), and top rigid (u_x=0, u_y=u_top)

phase_field_d.irreversibility_rule: d*(x) >= d_prior(x) for all x in Omega (zero healing: min Delta d >= 0)
phase_field_d.slit_condition: Discontinuous jump across slit flank nodes strictly preserved; zero cross-slit smoothing
phase_field_d.variational_regularization: L2 mass-matrix projection / variational weighting across nonmatching boundaries

crack_driving_history_H.mapping_rule: Isoparametric evaluation from containing donor element integration points
crack_driving_history_H.admissibility: H*(x_qp) >= 0.0 everywhere; local KKT complementarity satisfied
crack_driving_history_H.svars_allocation: 18 internal state variables per element mapped to restart UEL storage

patch_test_1_constant_field.description: Constant scalar field d=0.420 and vector displacement u0=(1.5e-3, -2.0e-3)
